extensions.name: Web Open Font Format 2
extensions.description_pt: Formato de fonte comprimido desenvolvido para utilização na web, oferecendo arquivos menores e carregamento eficiente.
extensions.description_en: Compressed font format designed for web use, offering smaller files and efficient loading.
extensions.compression: Brotli
disadvantages: Not supported by some legacy applications

extensions.name: Scalable Vector Graphics
extensions.description_pt: Formato de imagem vetorial baseado em XML, utilizado para criar gráficos que podem ser redimensionados sem perder qualidade.
extensions.description_en: XML-based vector image format used to create graphics that can be resized without losing quality.
extensions.compression: None by default; can be compressed with gzip or Brotli
extensions.magic_number: No fixed signature; commonly begins with <svg or an XML declaration
disadvantages: Can become complex for detailed graphics
May require sanitization when accepting untrusted files

extensions.name: JavaScript Object Notation
extensions.description_pt: Formato textual utilizado para armazenar e transmitir dados estruturados de maneira organizada.
extensions.description_en: Text-based format used to store and transmit structured data.
extensions.developer: Douglas Crockford; standardized by the IETF
extensions.compression: None by default; can be compressed with gzip, Brotli or Zstandard
disadvantages: Does not support comments in standard JSON
Does not define a schema by itself

extensions.name: Portable Document Format
extensions.description_pt: Formato de documento desenvolvido para preservar a aparência, a estrutura e a apresentação do conteúdo em diferentes dispositivos.
extensions.description_en: Document format designed to preserve the appearance, structure and presentation of content across different devices.
extensions.compression: Depends on the contents; supports Flate, JPEG, JPEG 2000 and other filters

extensions.name: Microsoft Word Open XML Document
extensions.description_pt: Formato de documento baseado em XML utilizado pelo Microsoft Word para armazenar textos, imagens, tabelas e outros elementos.
extensions.description_en: XML-based document format used by Microsoft Word to store text, images, tables and other elements.
extensions.compression: ZIP container with XML files

extensions.name: Portable Network Graphics
extensions.description_pt: Formato de imagem rasterizada que utiliza compressão sem perdas e oferece suporte à transparência.
extensions.description_en: Raster image format that uses lossless compression and supports transparency.
extensions.compression: DEFLATE
disadvantages: Can produce large files for photographs
Does not natively support animation in the original PNG format

extensions.name: JPEG Image
extensions.description_pt: Formato de imagem que utiliza compressão com perdas, muito utilizado para fotografias e imagens digitais.
extensions.description_en: Image format that uses lossy compression and is widely used for photographs and digital images.
extensions.compression: JPEG lossy compression

extensions.name: MPEG Audio Layer III
extensions.description_pt: Formato de áudio digital comprimido utilizado para armazenar músicas, gravações e outros conteúdos sonoros.
extensions.description_en: Compressed digital audio format used to store music, recordings and other audio content.
extensions.compression: Lossy perceptual audio compression
extensions.magic_number: No single fixed signature; ID3 metadata commonly starts with 49 44 33

extensions.name: MPEG-4 Part 14
extensions.description_pt: Formato de contêiner multimídia utilizado para armazenar vídeos, áudio, legendas e outros dados.
extensions.description_en: Multimedia container format used to store video, audio, subtitles and other data.
extensions.compression: Depends on the contained codecs, such as H.264, H.265 and AAC
extensions.magic_number: Usually contains ftyp at byte offset 4
advantages: Supports multiple audio and video codecs

extensions.name: ZIP Archive
extensions.description_pt: Formato de arquivo compactado que permite armazenar vários arquivos e diretórios em um único pacote.
extensions.description_en: Compressed archive format that allows multiple files and directories to be stored in a single package.
extensions.compression: DEFLATE and other supported ZIP compression methods
disadvantages: Some archives require passwords or special tools

extensions.name: HyperText Markup Language
extensions.description_pt: Linguagem de marcação utilizada para estruturar páginas, documentos e conteúdos da Web.
extensions.description_en: Markup language used to structure web pages, documents and web content.
extensions.developer: WHATWG and World Wide Web Consortium (W3C)
extensions.compression: None by default; web servers can use gzip or Brotli
extensions.magic_number: No fixed signature; commonly begins with <!DOCTYPE html>
disadvantages: Does not define visual styling by itself
Requires a browser or compatible renderer for visual presentation

extensions.name: Cascading Style Sheets
extensions.description_pt: Linguagem de folhas de estilo utilizada para definir a apresentação visual de documentos HTML e XML.
extensions.description_en: Style sheet language used to define the visual presentation of HTML and XML documents.
extensions.compression: None by default; web servers can use gzip or Brotli
disadvantages: Large stylesheets can become difficult to maintain

extensions.name: Python Source File
extensions.description_pt: Arquivo de código-fonte escrito na linguagem de programação Python, utilizado para criar programas, scripts e aplicações.
extensions.description_en: Source code file written in the Python programming language, used to create programs, scripts and applications.
extensions.developer: Python Software Foundation and Python community
extensions.compression: None by default
disadvantages: Requires a Python interpreter to run source files

extensions.name: Graphics Interchange Format
extensions.description_pt: Formato de imagem que suporta animações e transparência com uma paleta limitada de cores.
extensions.description_en: Image format supporting animations and transparency with a limited color palette.
extensions.compression: LZW

extensions.name: WebP Image
extensions.description_pt: Formato moderno de imagem desenvolvido para a web, com suporte a compressão com e sem perdas, transparência e animação.
extensions.description_en: Modern web image format supporting lossy and lossless compression, transparency and animation.
extensions.compression: VP8-based lossy and lossless compression
disadvantages: Some older applications may not support it

extensions.name: AV1 Image File Format
extensions.description_pt: Formato de imagem baseado no AV1, desenvolvido para oferecer alta eficiência de compressão e boa qualidade visual.
extensions.description_en: AV1-based image format designed to provide high compression efficiency and good visual quality.
extensions.compression: AV1
extensions.magic_number: Usually contains ftypavif at byte offset 4

extensions.name: Tagged Image File Format
extensions.description_pt: Formato de imagem utilizado principalmente em fotografia, digitalização e publicação profissional.
extensions.description_en: Image format mainly used in photography, scanning and professional publishing.
extensions.developer: Aldus Corporation; later maintained by Adobe
extensions.compression: Uncompressed, LZW, ZIP, JPEG and other supported methods
disadvantages: Not supported by every web browser

extensions.name: Bitmap Image File
extensions.description_pt: Formato de imagem rasterizada utilizado principalmente em sistemas Windows.
extensions.description_en: Raster image format mainly used in Windows systems.
extensions.compression: Usually uncompressed; some variants support compression

extensions.name: Windows Icon File
extensions.description_pt: Formato de arquivo utilizado para armazenar ícones em diferentes tamanhos e resoluções.
extensions.description_en: File format used to store icons in different sizes and resolutions.
extensions.compression: Uncompressed bitmap or PNG-compressed image data
disadvantages: Limited compared with modern image formats

extensions.name: High Efficiency Image Container
extensions.description_pt: Formato de imagem baseado no HEIF, frequentemente utilizado por dispositivos móveis para armazenar fotografias com alta eficiência.
extensions.description_en: HEIF-based image format frequently used by mobile devices to store photographs efficiently.
extensions.compression: HEVC
extensions.magic_number: Usually contains ftypheic or ftypheix at byte offset 4

extensions.name: Waveform Audio File Format
extensions.description_pt: Formato de áudio digital utilizado para armazenar gravações e áudio sem compressão ou com diferentes métodos de codificação.
extensions.description_en: Digital audio format used to store recordings and audio without compression or with different encoding methods.
extensions.compression: Usually uncompressed PCM

extensions.name: Free Lossless Audio Codec
extensions.description_pt: Formato de áudio que utiliza compressão sem perdas, preservando os dados sonoros originais.
extensions.description_en: Audio format using lossless compression, preserving the original audio data.
extensions.compression: FLAC lossless compression
disadvantages: Larger files than lossy audio formats

extensions.name: Ogg Multimedia Container
extensions.description_pt: Formato de contêiner multimídia aberto utilizado para armazenar áudio, vídeo e outros fluxos de dados.
extensions.description_en: Open multimedia container format used to store audio, video and other data streams.
extensions.compression: Depends on the contained codec, commonly Vorbis or Opus
disadvantages: Compatibility depends on the contained codec

extensions.name: Matroska Video
extensions.description_pt: Formato de contêiner multimídia capaz de armazenar vídeo, áudio, legendas e capítulos.
extensions.description_en: Multimedia container format capable of storing video, audio, subtitles and chapters.
extensions.compression: Depends on contained codecs
disadvantages: Some devices have limited native support

extensions.name: QuickTime Movie
extensions.description_pt: Formato de contêiner multimídia desenvolvido para armazenar vídeos, áudio e outros tipos de dados.
extensions.description_en: Multimedia container format developed to store video, audio and other types of data.
extensions.compression: Depends on contained codecs, such as ProRes and H.264
extensions.magic_number: Often contains ftypqt at byte offset 4 in ISO-based variants; older files vary

extensions.name: Audio Video Interleave
extensions.description_pt: Formato de contêiner multimídia desenvolvido pela Microsoft para armazenar áudio e vídeo.
extensions.description_en: Multimedia container format developed by Microsoft to store audio and video.
extensions.compression: Depends on the contained video and audio codecs

extensions.name: WebM Video
extensions.description_pt: Formato de contêiner multimídia aberto projetado principalmente para utilização na web.
extensions.description_en: Open multimedia container format designed primarily for web use.
extensions.compression: VP8, VP9 or AV1 video; Vorbis or Opus audio
extensions.encoding: Binary, based on Matroska and EBML
disadvantages: Compatibility depends on codecs and devices

extensions.name: 7-Zip Archive
extensions.description_pt: Formato de arquivo compactado desenvolvido para oferecer alta taxa de compressão e suporte a diferentes métodos.
extensions.description_en: Archive format developed to provide high compression ratios and support for different methods.
extensions.compression: LZMA, LZMA2, PPMd and other methods

extensions.name: Roshal Archive
extensions.description_pt: Formato de arquivo compactado utilizado para armazenar e distribuir conjuntos de arquivos.
extensions.description_en: Compressed archive format used to store and distribute collections of files.
extensions.compression: RAR compression algorithms

extensions.name: Tape Archive
extensions.description_pt: Formato de arquivamento utilizado para reunir vários arquivos e diretórios em um único arquivo, sem necessariamente comprimi-los.
extensions.description_en: Archive format used to combine multiple files and directories into a single file without necessarily compressing them.
extensions.compression: None by default; often combined with gzip, bzip2 or xz
extensions.encoding: Binary archive with textual metadata fields
extensions.magic_number: No fixed signature; ustar marker appears at offset 257 in compatible archives
disadvantages: Does not compress files by itself

extensions.name: GZIP Compressed File
extensions.description_pt: Formato de compressão utilizado para reduzir o tamanho de arquivos, frequentemente encontrado em sistemas Unix e Linux.
extensions.description_en: Compression format used to reduce file sizes, frequently found in Unix and Linux systems.
extensions.compression: DEFLATE
disadvantages: Usually compresses one file stream at a time
Does not provide file grouping by itself

extensions.name: Android Package Kit
extensions.description_pt: Formato de pacote utilizado para distribuir e instalar aplicativos no sistema operacional Android.
extensions.description_en: Package format used to distribute and install applications on the Android operating system.
extensions.developer: Google and Android Open Source Project
extensions.compression: ZIP container; individual entries may be compressed or stored
extensions.encoding: Binary package containing resources, metadata and executable code
advantages: Can be installed on Android devices
disadvantages: Installation may be blocked by device security settings

extensions.name: Android App Bundle
extensions.description_pt: Formato de publicação de aplicativos Android que reúne código e recursos para gerar APKs otimizados para diferentes dispositivos.
extensions.description_en: Android app publishing format that combines code and resources to generate optimized APKs for different devices.
extensions.compression: ZIP-based package container
extensions.encoding: Binary package containing application resources and metadata
disadvantages: Cannot be installed directly like a regular APK

extensions.name: Windows Executable File
extensions.description_pt: Formato de arquivo executável utilizado principalmente para iniciar programas e aplicativos no Windows.
extensions.description_en: Executable file format mainly used to launch programs and applications on Windows.
extensions.compression: None by default; executable files may use specialized compression or packing
disadvantages: Unknown executables can pose security risks

extensions.name: Dynamic Link Library
extensions.description_pt: Arquivo de biblioteca dinâmica utilizado por programas Windows para compartilhar código, funções e recursos.
extensions.description_en: Dynamic library file used by Windows programs to share code, functions and resources.
extensions.compression: None by default
disadvantages: Dependency problems can prevent applications from working

extensions.name: JavaScript Source File
extensions.description_pt: Arquivo de código-fonte escrito em JavaScript, utilizado no desenvolvimento web, aplicações e ferramentas.
extensions.description_en: Source code file written in JavaScript, used in web development, applications and tools.
extensions.compression: None by default; can be compressed with gzip or Brotli
disadvantages: Dynamic typing can cause certain errors

extensions.name: TypeScript Source File
extensions.description_pt: Arquivo de código-fonte escrito em TypeScript, uma linguagem baseada em JavaScript que adiciona recursos de tipagem estática.
extensions.description_en: Source code file written in TypeScript, a JavaScript-based language that adds static typing features.
extensions.compression: None by default
disadvantages: Usually requires compilation or a compatible runtime

extensions.name: Extensible Markup Language
extensions.description_pt: Formato de marcação baseado em texto utilizado para estruturar, armazenar e transportar dados de maneira organizada e hierárquica.
extensions.description_en: Text-based markup format used to structure, store, and transport data in an organized hierarchical way.

extensions.name: YAML Ain't Markup Language
extensions.description_pt: Formato de serialização de dados legível por humanos, utilizado principalmente para arquivos de configuração e troca de informações.
extensions.description_en: Human-readable data serialization format mainly used for configuration files and information exchange.

extensions.name: Tom's Obvious Minimal Language
extensions.description_pt: Formato de arquivo de configuração simples e legível, projetado para ser fácil de interpretar por pessoas e programas.
extensions.description_en: Simple and readable configuration file format designed to be easy for both humans and programs to interpret.

extensions.name: Comma-Separated Values
extensions.description_pt: Formato de texto utilizado para armazenar dados tabulares, organizando valores em linhas e separando campos por delimitadores, geralmente vírgulas.
extensions.description_en: Text format used to store tabular data, organizing values into rows and separating fields with delimiters, usually commas.

extensions.name: OpenDocument Text
extensions.description_pt: Formato aberto de documentos de texto pertencente ao padrão OpenDocument, utilizado para armazenar textos formatados, imagens e outros elementos.
extensions.description_en: Open document format belonging to the OpenDocument standard, used to store formatted text, images, and other elements.

extensions.name: Electronic Publication
extensions.description_pt: Formato aberto de publicação digital utilizado principalmente para livros eletrônicos, permitindo texto adaptável e inclusão de imagens e outros conteúdos.
extensions.description_en: Open digital publication format mainly used for electronic books, supporting reflowable text, images, and other content.

extensions.name: Rust Source File
extensions.description_pt: Arquivo de código-fonte da linguagem Rust, utilizado para desenvolver aplicações e sistemas com foco em desempenho e segurança de memória.
extensions.description_en: Rust programming language source code file used to develop applications and systems focused on performance and memory safety.

extensions.name: Go Source File
extensions.description_pt: Arquivo de código-fonte da linguagem Go, utilizado no desenvolvimento de aplicações, serviços de rede e sistemas.
extensions.description_en: Go programming language source code file used to develop applications, network services, and systems.

extensions.name: Java Source File
extensions.description_pt: Arquivo de código-fonte da linguagem Java, utilizado para desenvolver aplicações multiplataforma, sistemas corporativos e aplicativos Android.
extensions.description_en: Java programming language source code file used to develop cross-platform applications, enterprise systems, and Android applications.

extensions.name: Kotlin Source File
extensions.description_pt: Arquivo de código-fonte da linguagem Kotlin, utilizado no desenvolvimento de aplicativos Android, aplicações multiplataforma e sistemas.
extensions.description_en: Kotlin programming language source code file used to develop Android applications, multiplatform applications, and systems.
